title: Grateful Dead Live at Onongada County War Memorial on 1982-04-08
lineage: (FOB) Senn 421 -> Cm (sony D5/Dolby B)-> Dat -> Behringer UltraMatch SRC 2000 ->M-Audio 2448 -> Samplitude 2496 v6.0 -> CD

ai_review.summary: Audience recording that’s clear but a bit bass‑heavy, capturing a mixed‑energy show with a smoking Let It Grow and fast Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The FOB captures an audience mix that is generally clear, though some listeners note a bass‑heavy tilt and aggressive Dolby compression that can swallow detail. Musically the concert swings between high‑octane moments – a standout Let It Grow and a rapid Eyes of the World – and more sluggish passages, with a weak closing on Stranger and uneven song flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between strong praise for certain songs and the performance versus criticism of recording fidelity and overall show energy, yielding an average rating around the low‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to be enjoyable, but described as a little bassy, B‑grade by one reviewer and suffering from aggressive Dolby compression that mutes mids. Overall considered decent for an audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set has moments of excitement but several reviewers note a lack of smooth transitions and an overall feeling that the band was not fully engaged.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for committing to the audience and delivering strong guitar work, though one reviewer felt the band seemed reluctant to play that night.
